record.question: What deals with legal responsibilities of physician arising out of Doctor-patient relationship like consent, negligence, confidentiality, right and duties of physicians?
record.explanation: Answer C: Medical Jurisprudence. Medical jurisprudence applies legal principles to physician duties and the doctor–patient relationship, including consent, negligence, confidentiality, and rights. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK470379/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
